name: Sudan
value: Drone war on grid; power cut in cities
summary: RSF-blamed drone strikes push Sudan's power grid near collapse; Khartoum accuses Ethiopia of strikes
state: Drone strikes blamed on the RSF have hit power stations and left major cities without electricity, pushing the grid near collapse, AP reported on 1 Nov. On 3 Nov Sudan's government accused Ethiopia of launching drone strikes on civilian infrastructure and power stations (Sudan Tribune). An IPC alert on 13 Oct warned that drought and war are pushing Darfur and Kordofan towards famine.
for_you: Follow FCDO advice against all travel to Sudan.
rubric_hit: Major attacks on civilian infrastructure and famine risk spreading = Alert

sources.title: AP via NY1 — Sudan's power grid nears collapse as drone strikes target electric stations
Sudan Tribune — Sudan accuses Ethiopia of drone strikes on power stations

why: The world's largest displacement and hunger crisis; regional spillover into Chad, South Sudan and the Red Sea.
drivers: SAF–RSF fighting, sieges, foreign arms supplies, aid access, famine.

rubric.alert: Major sieges or massacres reported, or famine spreading to new areas.
